sections.t: Lower A done: a 55-minute lifting session in the morning, plus a 2.25 km recovery walk. Two sessions this week so far, both on plan.

Upper A: lat pulldown, barbell bent-over row, seated DB shoulder press, lateral raise, biceps curl, lying leg raise, plank, then a 3 km easy run. Last Wednesday's run went out at 7:53/km, so aim for 8:30-9:00/km or slower and keep it conversational.

Lift plus run today, so put most of your carbs around training while staying near 1,750 kcal and 130 g protein. Have Protein overnight oats before the gym and a Chicken and potato tray bake for dinner.
Your longest run in the past 30 days is 3.0 km, so keep Sunday's long run at about 3.3 km rather than the planned 3.6 km.
